mintAuthority.summary: ebUSD is minted from Liquity-v2-style CDP branches when users open troves. The BoldToken is an OZ ERC1967Proxy; after setCollateralRegistry() the BoldToken owner was renounced (owner()=0x0). Upgrades are governed by a Gnosis Safe 2/3 (3 EOA owners) via EbisuUpgradeableV2 with a mandatory 7-day on-chain timelock. No pending upgrade exists. CCIP token pools are locked. CDP branches (BorrowerOperations) are the only mint path and their addresses are immutable in the CollateralRegistry.

controls.label: Ebisu CDP BorrowerOperations contracts (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded per branch by collateral ratio and Liquity-v2-style redemption/liquidation; users set their own interest rate. Mint is gated to registered BorrowerOperations addresses set at initialization.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295272: BoldToken (ebUSD) is an ERC1967Proxy (0x09fd37d9...) with impl BoldToken (0xa5ae6f43...). Source-confirmed: setCollateralRegistry() renounces ownership (owner()=0x0 at slot 101). Upgrade admin is Gnosis Safe 2/3 (0x25b85831..., 3 EOA owners, no modules, Safe 1.3.0) gated by 7-day on-chain UPGRADE_TIMELOCK in EbisuUpgradeableV2. No pending upgrade (pendingImplementation=0x0). ccipTokenPoolsLocked=true; the CCIP pool path is therefore a locked native-token guard, not an active bridge mint route. Mint is CDP-only via BorrowerOperations addresses set at init and unreachable without an upgrade through the 7-day timelock. LayerZero OFT adapters are transfer machinery reviewed separately under Bridge Risk and do not replace the native CDP controls. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: collateral-gated CDP issuance can be changed only through the enforced seven-day upgrade timelock, requires no off-chain reconciliation, and has no supervisor or attestor.
